result.stdout:
DESCRIPTION:
Add a project entry to this week's dev-log

USAGE:
    dev-log add <PROJECT> [OPTIONS]

EXAMPLES:
    dev-log add MyProject -f .

ARGUMENTS:
    <PROJECT>    The name of the project to add the dev-log entry for

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help      Prints help information                                     
    -f, --folder    The folder path where dev-log files are stored              
    -d, --date      The date for the dev-log entry (defaults to today). Format: 
                    MM-dd-yyyy
